spec.title: Tech Newsletter Sponsorship Opportunities
spec.intent_summary: Collect information about tech newsletters that accept paid sponsorships, including audience size and pricing.

source_strategy.rationale: Surfacing verified tech newsletter media kits and sponsorship prospectuses.

source_docs.title: TechPulse Weekly Sponsorship Media Kit
source_docs.text:
TechPulse Weekly is a curated developer publication. Newsletter Name: TechPulse Weekly. Audience Size: 65,000 subscribers. Niche: AI and Cloud Engineering. Sponsorship Pricing: $2,500 USD per issue. Contact Email: sponsor@techpulse.dev. Newsletter URL: https://techpulse.dev/sponsor.

ByteByteGo Newsletter provides deep dives into distributed system architecture. Newsletter Name: ByteByteGo. Audience Size: 500,000 subscribers. Niche: System Design and Software Architecture. Sponsorship Pricing: $8,000 USD per issue. Contact Email: partnerships@bytebytego.com. Newsletter URL: https://bytebytego.com/sponsor.
